options.name: Assault
options.description: Legacy maps where attackers capture two sequential points; currently only in Arcade.

options.name: Clash
options.description: A specialized map type with specific rules.

options.name: Flashpoint
options.description: Asymmetrical maps with unique objectives, such as Malevento.

options.name: Push
options.description: A new mode introduced in Overwatch 2 involving pushing a destructible object.

options.name: Control
options.description: Teams fight for control of a single objective in a best-of-three format across three sub-maps.

options.name: Hybrid
options.description: A combination of Assault and Escort; attackers capture a point, then escort a payload.

options.name: Escort
options.description: Attackers move a payload through checkpoints to a destination.
